translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: only the youkai unit whose numbers were halved.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: The main generals had gathered in the great hall.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and this was likely the final war council.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: to protect him.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: making the war council feel very lonely.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: But no one dared to mention it.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「こうしていると……」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「When we are like this......」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and before we knew it became the strongest single army.」

「……あんな奴の手なんて必要ない」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Those who remain here are all warriors worth a thousand.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 俺はここにいる皆を信頼している」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I trust everyone here.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「そして戦うべき理由が、
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「And we have reasons to fight,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: things worth risking our lives to protect.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「どうして俺達が負けよう」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Why would we lose?」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「もう少しの辛抱。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Just endure a little longer.
